Name: seven-mixed-composition-vs-boss-point-target
DisplayName: Seven split across archetypes vs Boss (distinctness cost)
Description: task-143. A 7-body squad split across the archetypes CLASSES.md's four hero identities survive as under the castle pivot (Q29=A) -- as many of them as this harness can express with committed stat blocks -- vs a uniform 7-body squad (seven-melee-veteran-vs-boss-point-target.json) at the same total headcount. Answers whether Q13=C's required distinctness costs boss-TTK or is a pure legibility argument.
SourceRefs: docs/OPEN-DECISIONS.md Q29 = A (the four classes become the seven's archetypes)
CLASSES.md §1 Vanguard, §3 Pathfinder, §4 Lampbearer ('The Guided don't hold lines or deal real damage: they sustain')
docs/data/upgrades.json tier_ladder veteran row / docs/data/unit-types.json archers combat block
Notes: SIMPLIFICATION, stated plainly rather than hidden: only 2 of the 4 surviving archetypes have a committed combat stat block anywhere in docs/data -- melee Spearmen (proxying Vanguard) and ranged Archers (proxying Pathfinder). The Relickeeper (fortifier/prevention -- walls, wards, damage reduction) has NO committed HP/DPS/Armor number to stand in for and is not represented in this Count total at all, not even at zero -- omitted rather than invented. The Lampbearer (CLASSES.md §4: 'The Guided don't hold lines or deal real damage: they sustain') is represented as the MISSING 7th body -- 4+2=6, one squad slot deliberately left out of the DPS sum rather than invented a nonzero number for it, since CLASSES.md states its zero-damage design intent explicitly (not a number this doc is inventing). Read this scenario's TTK against seven-melee-veteran-vs-boss-point-target.json's 7-of-7-damaging-bodies TTK as 'what a 6-damaging-body, 2-role split costs relative to 7 uniform bodies of the same tier' -- NOT as a full 4-archetype roster, which this harness cannot build from committed data.
